project_type: FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Workers edge + React frontend, deployed on Azure Container Apps
build_system: pip-compile for Python deps, pnpm for Node deps, Docker for backend container
test_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r /tmp/requirements-nohash.txt && pytest tests/ --tb=short -q (with APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest on backend tests. 2. Run vitest on edge tests. 3. Ensure Docker builds successfully.
setup_instructions: 1. pip install deps from requirements.txt (strip hashes first). 2. pnpm install for edge/frontend. 3. Set APP_ENV=test and JWT_SECRET for tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Docker daemon available for container builds.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns. Tests required.
key_patterns: Singleton service instances (search_service, razorpay_client, vertex_client). Pydantic BaseSettings for config. Beanie ODM for MongoDB. Upstash Redis via HTTP. HTTPBearer for auth. asynccontextmanager lifespan pattern in main.py. Module-level get_redis()/get_mongo_client() accessors. SSE streaming for chat.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI application (api/, core/, db/, models/, services/, utils/). apps/edge/src/ - Cloudflare Worker (middleware/, routes/, utils/). apps/frontend/ - React SPA. .github/workflows/ - CI/CD and agent workflows. infra/ - Infrastructure configs.
